entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned Counsel for the Petitioner and the State.

2. By means of this application, the Petitioner seeks grant of bail U/s.438 Cr.P.C. in apprehension of arrest for his alleged involvement in the offences U/s. 376(2)(n)/406/506/323/34 IPC.
3.

Keeping in view the submission of the parties and having gone through the nature of allegations as emerged from the material on record and further the circumstances appearing, the seriousness and gravity of the offences, while this Court is not inclined to grant anticipatory bail, the Petitioner is at liberty to surrender before the learned SDJM, Bhubaneswar in connection with Bhubaneswar Mahila PS Case No.36 of 2024 corresponding to CT Case No.330 of 2024 within three weeks from today and moves for bail the learned court in seisin over the matter shall consider the bail // 2 //
Signed by: ANANTA KUMAR PRADHAN application of the Petitioner in the first hour of the day,
strictly on Location: HIGH COURT OF ORISSA Date: 16-Apr-2024 18:50:17 the basis of the materials available on record on its own merit.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In case of rejection of the bail application by the learned court, the Petitioner may move for bail before the higher forum in the second hour of the same day.

In that event, the higher forum shall consider and dispose of the bail application of the Petitioner on its own merit in the manner as ordinarily it deals with such matter not giving any emphasis for having directed for disposal.
5. Case diary be made available to the learned courts below.
6. The Petitioner is permitted to raise the points before the learned court in seisin over the matter.
7. The ABLAPL is disposed of accordingly.
(Chittaranjan Dash) Judge AKPradhan Debabrata Martha vs State Of Odisha ....
